sourceEvidence.title: Plant Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
- Lead all daily plant operations across production, fulfillment, and shipping
- Drive execution to meet aggressive ship dates in a high-volume, short lead-time environment
- Maintain full visibility across all orders and actively “order chase” to ensure nothing falls behind
- Ensure operational readiness from close to open, including staffing, materials, and priorities

### Throughput & Efficiency

- Improve output across all departments, with a strong focus on bottleneck identification and resolution
- Drive labor efficiency and manage payroll within budget expectations
- Implement process improvements to increase throughput without adding unnecessary cost
- Balance workload across departments to maintain consistent production flow

### Team Leadership & Accountability

- Lead, coach, and develop supervisors and production teams across the facility
- Establish and enforce clear performance expectations and daily metrics
- Hold teams accountable to productivity, quality, and safety standards
- Build a culture of urgency, ownership, and continuous improvement
